spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the parse/generate split found in Chromium source (no gate in the selector parser, a gated UpdatePseudoElement) and its migration consequence.

interactive.rationale: Four live probes, a re-run button, three strategy columns with real affordance outcomes, and clickable fallback/pseudo ⓘ.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card describes exactly what the page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: Shows the naive @supports strategy yielding NO affordance by default, the behavioural strategy always yielding exactly one, and the pseudo-only option.

conformance.rationale: It backs the feature suite: box-generated / opt-in / valid-source assertions run live. 6 pass and 2 blocked with the flag. Without it, 3 pass, 3 fail and 2 blocked, which is honest.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment). Run with default flags and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, at 1280x800 and at 360x740 DPR3 touch. Every control was exercised, console, pageerror and failed requests were all zero, and overflow was 0px in every run. Default: CSS.supports true, @supports applies, and no box (MISMATCH). Strategy A gives nothing, B gives the fallback, and the fallback opens its card. Flag: all three show the real pseudo.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the primary contract and the labelled fallback branch, and load-time asserts wait for DOMContentLoaded because the telemetry script is deferred.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only. Button background overrides also set color, and contrast is checked (accent-blue on paper is 7.86:1).

accessibility.rationale: The fallback buttons have aria-labels, the outcomes are aria-live, and the code blocks wrap.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow on both classes. The strategy columns stack on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Re-test once the feature ships
openQuestions.detail: When HTMLInterestForInterestButtonPseudo becomes stable, the mismatch disappears in Chrome. Keep the page as a migration record for older builds and update the copy.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detection progressive enhancement css selector supports
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Feature-detect interest invokers with HTMLButtonElement.prototype.hasOwnProperty('interestForElement') and load fallbacks only when they are needed.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: That check is used for the parent feature. For the pseudo, the guidance has no recipe, so the exception is that we measure the generated box: @supports was shown to be wrong in Chrome 153 (it parses without generating).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel form without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid/flex with minmax(0,1fr), min-width:0 and overflow-wrap so long tokens cannot widen the layout.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The stages are min-width:0 grids, and headings and code use overflow-wrap:anywhere. This fixed a measured 30px overflow on the inspector at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async status with a single polite region, and size targets at least 24px (bump them up on coarse pointers).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Logs use role=log or polite regions. The pseudo and fallback buttons have min 44x44px and every other control is 44px tall.

summary: Built and self-reviewed in the same pass. Evidence is from headless Chrome 153 with and without the runtime flag. chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable, so accessibility-tree claims are unverified.
